Write a parametrized test using tuple argnames to test a zip_two(a, b) helper that pairs items with a default fill.

def zip_two(a, b, fill=None):
    length = max(len(a), len(b))
    return [(a[i] if i < len(a) else fill, b[i] if i < len(b) else fill) for i in range(length)]
